E0002 (n=64, seed 0): top-1 accuracy 0.0, mean IO-S logit diff -1.31 +/- 7.43 (SE ~0.93); top predictions are unrelated tokens (" Declaration", " woes"). Prediction of >=0.8 accuracy REFUTED. E0003 (n=200, seed 1): accuracy 0.0, mean logit diff -0.29 +/- 6.96 (SE ~0.49), confirmed within [-2, 2]. Clean and corrupt means are almost identical (-1.31 vs -1.18; -0.29 vs -0.32) and the per-prompt clean and corrupt values in E0002 track each other although the corrupt prompts contain different names: the logit diff is set by which two answer tokens are compared, not by the sentence. Hypothesis "model does the behaviour" rejected.
